leaves 5.0 mm of bolt protruding into camera","value":5},"coupon_length":{"kind":"design","note":"Length along the rail for the quick fit-check coupon","source":"design","value":15,"unit":"mm"},"bolt_thread_d":{"note":"1/4-20 major thread diameter (1/4 inch)","unit":"mm","value":6.35,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"head_clearance":{"source":"design","kind":"design","unit":"mm","note":"Clearance added to bolt head diameter for the recessed pocket (pocket width 17.0 mm)","value":2},"bolt_head_h":{"unit":"mm","value":5,"note":"Salvaged webcam mount bolt head height","source":"measured","kind":"hardware"},"clamp_width":{"kind":"world","source":"measured","note":"Tripod clamp dovetail receiver width (Arca-Swiss standard 38 mm)","value":38,"unit":"mm"}},"note":"Arca-Swiss compatible quick-release camera plate (38 mm standard dovetail, 45 mm length) verified to fit the tripod clamp and salvaged webcam mount bolt.","questions":[],"parts":[{"role":"final","id":"arca_plate","print_orientation":"camera-contact face flat on print bed (z = 0)","material":"PLA","use_orientation":"camera-contact face facing up (+z in use), clamped into tripod below (-z in use)","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    import cadquery as cq

    total_h = p.flange_h + p.dovetail_h
    half_w = p.clamp_width / 2.0
    angle_rad = math.radians(p.dovetail_angle)
    bevel_dx = p.dovetail_h * math.tan(angle_rad)
    bottom_half_w = half_w - bevel_dx

    # Plate profile in XZ plane: camera face is at z = 0 (on the print bed)
    pts = [
        (-half_w, 0.0),
        (half_w, 0.0),
        (half_w, p.flange_h),
        (bottom_half_w, total_h),
        (-bottom_half_w, total_h),
        (-half_w, p.flange_h),
    ]

    body = (
        cq.Workplane("XZ")
        .polyline(pts)
        .close()
        .extrude(p.plate_length / 2.0, both=True)
    )

    # 1/4"-20 through-slot:
    slot_w = p.bolt_thread_d + p.bolt_clearance
    slot_l = slot_w + p.slot_travel
    straight_slot = slot_l - slot_w
    r_slot = slot_w / 2.0

    c1 = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .center(0.0, -straight_slot / 2.0)
        .circle(r_slot)
        .extrude(total_h + 2.0)
    )
    c2 = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .center(0.0, straight_slot / 2.0)
        .circle(r_slot)
        .extrude(total_h + 2.0)
    )
    bx = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .center(0.0, 0.0)
        .rect(slot_w, straight_slot)
        .extrude(total_h + 2.0)
    )
    slot_cutter = c1.union(c2).union(bx)
    body = body.cut(slot_cutter)

    # Bolt head counterbore pocket from z = seat_thickness to top:
    pocket_w = p.bolt_head_d + p.head_clearance
    pocket_l = pocket_w + p.slot_travel
    straight_pkt = pocket_l - pocket_w
    r_pkt = pocket_w / 2.0
    pkt_h = total_h - p.seat_thickness + 2.0

    p1 = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=p.seat_thickness)
        .center(0.0, -straight_pkt / 2.0)
        .circle(r_pkt)
        .extrude(pkt_h)
    )
    p2 = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=p.seat_thickness)
        .center(0.0, straight_pkt / 2.0)
        .circle(r_pkt)
        .extrude(pkt_h)
    )
    pbx = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=p.seat_thickness)
        .center(0.0, 0.0)
        .rect(pocket_w, straight_pkt)
        .extrude(pkt_h)
    )
    pocket_cutter = p1.union(p2).union(pbx)
    body = body.cut(pocket_cutter)

    return body

    bevel_dx = p.dovetail_h * math.tan(angle_rad)
    bottom_half_w = half_w - bevel_dx

    pts = [
        (-half_w, 0.0),
        (half_w, 0.0),
        (half_w, p.flange_h),

        (-bottom_half_w, total_h),
        (-half_w, p.flange_h),
    ]

    body = (
        cq.Workplane("XZ")
        .polyline(pts)
        .close()
        .extrude(p.coupon_length / 2.0, both=True)
    )

    # Central hole for bolt:
    hole_d = p.bolt_thread_d + p.bolt_clearance
    hole = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(hole_d / 2.0).extrude(total_h + 2.0)

        .workplane(offset=p.seat_thickness)
        .circle(pocket_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(pkt_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(cbore)

    return body
